path.description: Path to export; defaults to home directory if omitted.

port.description: Port to listen on; 0 means random (default).

bind_local.description: If true, listen only on loopback; if false, listen on all interfaces.

no_mdns.description: If true, disable mDNS/DNS-SD service broadcasting.

htdigest_path.description: Path to htdigest file for Digest authentication.

realm.description: Digest authentication realm; must match the realm used when generating the htdigest file.

verbose.description: If true, print verbose runtime information.

current_user.description: Used to compute default path when path is not specified (not a chezdav flag, but used for template interpolation).
